Margin bridge and countermeasures
Operating margins contracted by 4.2% over Q3 because inbound freight per carton rose nineteen percent
and the prepaid fuel surcharge stuck at 9 dollars. We held list prices flat through the quarter, so the squeeze
showed up almost entirely in gross margin rather than in demand. Two countermeasures shipped in October:
a regional carrier swap on the western lanes cuts per-carton freight by a projected 11 percent, and
volume-tier surcharge caps lock our effective rate through peak season.
